Meta.title: Photnoo — Professional photo delivery
Meta.description: Deliver galleries to your clients with a private link, a password and proof of every download.

Home.title: Deliver your work the way it deserves.
Home.subtitle: Upload a gallery, send your client a private link and password, and get proof of every download. Files delete themselves when the link expires.
Home.invite: Photnoo is invite-only while we onboard our first photographers.

Steps.title: Three steps, no chasing
Steps.uploadBody: Drag in the whole shoot. Uploads resume if your connection drops.
Steps.sendBody: Share the link on WhatsApp and send the password separately.
Steps.proofBody: See when your client opened the gallery and what they downloaded.
